name: ROG Control
author: lucianosrp
description: Everything asusctl does for ASUS ROG laptops: Aura keyboard RGB with LED colour correction, Slash ledbar, platform profiles, CPU/GPU power-limit tuning, a fan-curve editor, charge limit, GPU MUX/Eco and firmware toggles, with a live illustration of your laptop. Talks to asusd directly over D-Bus.
